title: Alert
summary: Persistent inline notice with semantic roles, optional actions and dismiss behavior.

status.description: What the alert reports, in the shared status vocabulary. The words this component used before — clear and danger — are still accepted and mean neutral and error.

appearance.description: How the alert looks: a filled surface, an outline, or flat.

icon.description: Optional icon override. Use none to hide the semantic icon.

supporting-text.description: Supporting body text at the normal text size.

action-text.description: Visible label of the primary optional action.

action.description: Stable action value emitted in sf-alert-action.

secondary-action-text.description: Visible label of the secondary optional action.

secondary-action.description: Stable secondary action value emitted in sf-alert-action.

closable.description: Render an explicitly named close action.

close-label.description: Localized accessible name of the close action. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Close alert" in English).

type.description: Legacy name for status, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

variant.description: Legacy name for appearance, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

live_region_guidance.assertive: role=alert only for a newly inserted urgent message
live_region_guidance.polite: role=status for a newly inserted non-urgent update
live_region_guidance.static: omit a live-region role when the notice is present on initial page load

close.summary: Alias of dismiss(): dispatches sf-alert-close and removes the alert after its exit transition. Returns the element.

onAction.summary: Adds a listener for sf-alert-action; the handler receives (action, detail, event). Returns the element.

onClose.summary: Adds a listener for sf-alert-close; the handler receives (detail, event). Returns the element.

dismiss.summary: Dispatches sf-alert-close, then removes the alert from the DOM after its exit transition (at once under reduced motion). Returns the element.

sf-alert-action.summary: An action button ([data-action] or [data-alert-action]) inside the alert was activated. Bubbles and is composed; not cancelable. The alert stays.

action.description: The trigger's data-action or data-alert-action value; empty when neither is set.

sf-alert-close.summary: The alert is being dismissed by its close button or dismiss()/close(). Bubbles and is composed; not cancelable; the element is removed after it.

accessibility.focus: Actions use native focus-visible behavior; after dismissal the application restores focus only when it was inside the removed notice.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-alert for persistent inline guidance, warning, error or success feedback inside the page flow.
do_not: Do not use Alert for transient overlay feedback; use Toast
Do not choose a semantic type only for its color
Do not add role=alert to a static message that is already present on page load
Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
ai_guidance.minimal_example: <sf-alert status="info" title="Update available" supporting-text="Save your changes before refreshing."></sf-alert>
